venue.name: Gulf Islands Cruising School Ltd.
venue.description: Gulf Islands Cruising School Ltd. has provided boating instruction from Sidney since 1980 and is a Sail Canada member school, run by founders Bruce and Fran Stott. What it sells is certification and tuition for boat owners and prospective boat owners: the Pleasure Craft Operator Card, Sail Canada sail and power standards, a home-study Coastal Navigation course, the VHF Restricted Operator Certificate, Transport Canada accredited MED A3 and SVOP courses for commercial operators, and private instruction aboard the client's own boat. It also acts as a broker for charter companies. The site describes no school visit, youth program, camp, group rate or facility open to visitors, and instruction is priced per person or per instructor day, so this venue is recorded as not serving children's groups.
venue.seasonal_notes: We operate year round. The most popular months are April to September.

gaps: not for children's groups: every offering on the site is boating certification or private tuition sold to boat owners and their crew, priced per person or per instructor day. No school visit, daycare visit, youth course, camp, group rate or open facility is described anywhere, so hosts_school_groups and hosts_daycare_groups are set false and the programs array is empty

no minimum age is published for any course. The age table on the PCOC page is Transport Canada's age-horsepower restriction for operating a boat, not the school's own admission policy, so it was not used as a program age range

the only text about children or families is "We strongly encourage families to take the instruction together" on the private instruction page, which refers to a family learning to handle its own boat, not to an organised children's group
no category in the schema fits a private boating school; community_civic was used as the closest available value because the field cannot be null

no photographs were found on the site's own domain that are usable: the pages carry a logo, header graphics, an instructor headshot, an affiliate banner and a card icon, but no photograph of a boat, a classroom or the premises. The images array is therefore empty and there is no hero
the 10191 Third St address is given as a mailing address on the Contact Us page; the site does not say whether there is a public office or classroom at that address
no booking email is published; the contact page uses an embedded third-party form (formsmarts.com) and only a cell phone number is given directly
the site's footer copyright reads 2023 and several pages carry testimonials dated 2014 to 2021, so some content may be out of date
